head: 7a2c8b9
summary: 07_shell.js is unchanged since 87a5f4c, and every shell surface I measured is unchanged or moved within lighting tolerance. Window size, spacing, height, tubs, bezels, shades, dado, carpets and door linings are therefore unchanged in geometry and proportion. Base vs head, at more than 8 levels: q03 0 %; q07 0.00 % (one 5x10 px patch at x410-420, y115-119, in the distant aisle). q12 is 2.35 %, confined to rows 194-424 inside the pane (clouds); its surround stays 101/105/110 (L104) and its lip 63/65/66, both identical, and the joint is still clean. q14 is 1.83 %, all in rows 0-112, about 9-11 L darker on the ceiling/bin underside and the reveal tops (reveal top B-R +33 -> +34, upper wall 220/222/226 -> 218/220/223); the panes, tubs and lower wall are identical. q16 is 5.74 %, on the econ seat covers only; its pier, tub and carpet boxes are pixel-identical. The small PY darkening moves toward py_37301 (photo upper wall 180/187/201), so it is not a regression. Every earlier medium stays fixed. Only the carried lows remain, plus one lighting low that I am now logging explicitly: in the PY side view the tub reads cooler and darker than the wall (tub +28 vs wall +5), whereas in py_37301 the tub is lighter and more neutral than the wall (tub 226/231/237 +11 vs wall 176/186/205 +29). That is unchanged since base and is lighting. Score holds at 8.6.
